I found no bug in the production change. The test changes have two problems.

**`entry.go:287-288` (the change itself): no bug found.**
- `write()` now takes `Logger.mu` before calling `Formatter.Format`. That fixes the data race with `SetFormatter`, which also takes `mu`.
- The lock isn't held anywhere else when `write()` runs. `log()` and `fireHooks()` release it before calling `write()`, so I see no deadlock.
- One behavior change: `Format` now runs while the logger lock is held. A custom formatter that logs through the same logger, or calls a `Logger` method that locks, will now deadlock. Slow formatters will also serialize all logging, but that is the intended trade-off.

**`entry_test.go:285-300`, `TestEntryFormatterRace` (test bug, low severity)**
- The test starts goroutines and returns without waiting for them. There is no `sync.WaitGroup` and no `Wait`.
- The test can finish before any goroutine runs, so it may pass without exercising the race, even under `-race`. The same problem exists in `TestEntryReportCallerRace`, which this diff extends.
- Fix: add a `sync.WaitGroup` and wait for it before the test returns.

**`entry_test.go:273-276` and `entry_test.go:288-289` (test comment, nit)**
- The comments say "logging before SetReportCaller", but the formatter test calls `SetFormatter`.
- "Doing it twice" is copy-pasted, and "likelyhood" is misspelled.
- The extra `entry.Info` goroutine added to `TestEntryReportCallerRace` doesn't test anything new.

I only read the diff and the surrounding lock usage. I didn't run the tests or `go test -race`.
